app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.

rca_analyses_list.diagnosis: The geo service pod (geo-84fbc958c7-hs8mn) was repeatedly OOMKilled (Last State: Terminated, Exit Code 137; Restart Count: 3) and entering BackOff. While the pod was restarting/unavailable, search RPC calls to geo failed with gRPC Unavailable errors which propagated back to frontend (frontend -> search -> geo). Concrete evidence: frontend traces show the error "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available" (e.g. traceID 4bf1e3d2a383ff0e) for the search->geo call; the geo pod describe shows Last State Terminated Exit Code 137, Restart Count 3 and BackOff events; search logs show it attempted to register and then its spans show the Unavailable response from geo.

args.root_cause: The geo service pod (geo-84fbc958c7-hs8mn) was repeatedly OOMKilled (Last State: Terminated, Exit Code 137; Restart Count: 3) and entering BackOff. While the pod was restarting/unavailable, search RPC calls to geo failed with gRPC Unavailable errors which propagated back to frontend (frontend -> search -> geo). Concrete evidence: frontend traces show the error "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available" (e.g. traceID 4bf1e3d2a383ff0e) for the search->geo call; the geo pod describe shows Last State Terminated Exit Code 137, Restart Count 3 and BackOff events; search logs show it attempted to register and then its spans show the Unavailable response from geo.
args.evidence_summary: 1) Traces: frontend error traces (get_traces for service 'frontend') returned 20 error traces; example trace (get_trace 4bf1e3d2a383ff0e) shows spans for /search.Search/Nearby and /geo.Geo/Nearby with tag response_code=Unavailable and logs: "rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = there is no connection available". 2) search pod logs: search registered successfully in Consul (registry log: "Successfully registered in consul"). 3) Endpoints for service 'search' show the search pod IP (10.244.1.30) and port 8082, so Service -> Search pod connectivity is present. 4) geo pod describe (kubectl describe pod geo-84fbc958c7-hs8mn) shows Last State: Terminated Exit Code: 137, Restart Count: 3 and events include BackOff restarting failed container. 5) geo pod logs only show startup snippet "Initializing DB connection..." and no healthy steady-state traces, indicating it was restarting during the incident.
args.investigation_summary: I inspected cluster pods/services in namespace test-hotel-reservation, then focused on frontend error traces which showed Unavailable errors when calling search. I confirmed search was running and registered with Consul and had endpoints. Traces pointed to search calling geo and receiving Unavailable. Describing the geo pod revealed it was being terminated with Exit Code 137 and repeatedly restarted (BackOff), making geo unavailable and causing the cascading gRPC Unavailable errors seen in traces and frontend. No misconfiguration of the search Service or endpoints was found.
